Description

This faintly glowing ball of light bobs gently in the air, the nebulous image of what might be a glowing orb visible somewhere in its depths.

Defense

AC 18, touch 18, flat-footed 12 (+1 deflect, +5 dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 17 [30] (5d6)

mp 11

Fort +1, Ref +9, Will +7

Defensive Abilities natural invisibility;

Immune magic;

Offense

Speed fly 50 ft.(perfect)

Melee Shock +8 touch (1d8 non-elemental damage)

Special Abilities Fiddle

Spells Known (FC CL 5th, Concentration +8)

At will (DC 13) - detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 14) - ruin

2nd (DC 15) - poison

Statistics

Str 1, Dex 20, Con 10, Int 15, Wis 16, Cha 14

Base Atk +2; CMB -4; CMD 13

Feats Alertness, Dodge, Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +12, Bluff +9, Escape Artist +12, Fly +22, Perception +12, Stealth +16

Languages Aklo, Common

1/day, the wisp's ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle for 1 minute. The wisp creates a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper. A creature can resist this compulsion by making a successful Will save (DC 15). Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered for the duration of this spell. Once a creature makes the save against this spell, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that caster for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

save.description: Negates staggered dance; then immune to this wisp for 24 hours

description.value: Wisp are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except 2nd level spells or above.

effect: Ignore only spells and spell-like abilities below 2nd level that allow SR; other magic works normally.

description.value: Wisp have the ability to extinguish their natural glow as a move action, effectively becoming invisible, as per the spell. If they get hit or attack in any form they become visible for 1d4 rounds.

effect: Extinguish the glow to become invisible. Attacking or being hit makes the wisp visible for [[1d4]] rounds.

description.value: Invisible until it attacks or is hit.

contextNotes.text: Invisible, unless revealed; cannot resume invisibility for 1d4 rounds after a hit or attack.
